answer: Concrete sybil resistance via voyage anchoring: each agent must chart a voyage secured by a shale stake of 15,000 POA for 17 epochs; the stake erodes 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A thread of 13 rotating auditors samples each epoch output; divergent outputs trigger a 25% stake burn. New identities must wait 12 epochs before any payout. An attacker running N sybils must lock 15,000N POA for 17 epochs and survive 13 thread audits per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
